title: VentureRoutingManifest
description: Routing manifest for a venture, defining allowed model transitions, criticality mappings, and fallback paths.

dag.description: Directed Acyclic Graph of allowed model transitions. Each edge is a tuple [source, target].

criticality_map.description: Mapping from criticality levels to model tiers.

fallback_path.description: Ordered fallback path through the DAG. Must be a valid Hamiltonian path.

shadow.description: If true, log routing decisions without affecting production traffic (canary mode).

failure_threshold.description: Number of failures before circuit breaker trips.

recovery_window_sec.description: Time window (seconds) for recovery before allowing retries.
